Ron Paul Praises Cryptocurrencies
A Ron Paul paper titled The Dollar Dilemma: Where to From Here on June 22nd suggested that both cryptocurrencies and rare-earth elements might co-exist to work against a broken monetary system. Paul categorizes both cryptocurrencies and valuable metals as the very same, in the sense that both can be used as an option to fiat–.

As humorous as the comments and referrals might be, both camps need to recognize that a future decentralized society constructed on complimentary market principals will welcome both ways of exchange. There is no need for this division.

It required no main decree, acquired due to its unique attributes which made it ideal at a particular time.
